summary: Ten metres of steep kerb on a busy main road with no parking.
reasons: Main road, no cars parked here

best_section.where: east kerb of Hillsdon Road just north of the side street junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses 17-19 m away behind trees; the junction and bus route are right here.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is beside a junction mouth on a wide through road; trees overhang the verge and no cars park on this length.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on this kerb; a bus was in the older imagery.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the east verge; open to the west.
